name: Creative mode
author: VILIK
description: Choose creative before creating a world. Creative starts with tools in the quick bar, unlocks research, does not spend materials, disables health and oxygen, and double-tap space toggles flight. Middle-click with the build tool selects the part you are looking at. Shift-click stacks hull blocks in a line, the scroll wheel sets the length up to 16, and the next click places the line. Ctrl+Z undoes the last placement and Ctrl+Y restores it. Wood thrusters, generators, and distillers can be refilled or set to infinite fuel.
